messages:
sam: Quick design check — the console Dedicated dashboard feels a bit dense. Rows take up a lot of vertical space; engineers are asking for tighter lists. Thoughts on reducing row height vs keeping more metadata visible? cc @liz @maria

liz: I'm in favor of tightening paddings but we should keep the interactive target >=40px. Maybe collapse less-important metadata under a chevron or hover reveal.

maria: Also saw an a11y regression: keyboard nav loses focus after a toast appears. Repro'd on mac + VoiceOver.

sam: Yikes. Can you paste steps to repro?

maria: Steps:
1) Open /console/dedicated -> Jobs
2) Focus a row (click or arrow down)
3) Trigger a toast (e.g. start job)
Observed: focus jumps to document body and arrow keys stop moving between rows.

ben: That sounds like our toasts might be stealing focus or we have a focusable element with tabindex=0 being inserted. We should avoid moving focus for non-critical notices. Use aria-live="polite" role or role="status" and no autofocus.

oliver: On the density side, here's a quick CSS variant I sketched: ```css
.table-row { padding: 6px 10px; min-height: 44px; }
.table-row .meta { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
```
44px keeps us above the 40px touch minimum while saving vertical real estate vs the current 56px.

liz: Can we surface both variants in the console behind a feature flag so PMs/DS can run quick usability checks? A/B or canary would be ideal.

sam: Agreed. @eng-platform we'll need a toggle + metrics. Also: can we make toasts non-focusable by default and keep actions only keyboard-focusable if user opens the toast menu?

eng-bot: Deploy pipeline started for branch "console-row-density-canary". Build #2345.

maria: Minor copy nit: the "Retried" toast is terse — suggest "Job retried — attempting again" or similar to give context.

ben: Good call. I'll update toast components so copy is customizable via i18n strings and ensure the default role is `status` (no focus). Will also scan for tabindex insertion.

oliver: I'll open a PR with the CSS changes + keyboard e2e tests (arrow navigation across rows with toasts firing). Test plan will include voiceover and NVDA checks.

sam: Thanks team. Can we aim to have the canary up by EOD Thursday?

liz: Works for me.

ben: I'll land the toast changes today and tag oliver for the CSS PR review.

sam: Perfect — follow-up in #eng-platform once the flag is live. :rocket:
